In the USRSA-style table RPM Blast (273) is softer than Confidential (285) and Hyper-G (290), the opposite of TWU (RPM Blast 233 vs Confidential 222 lb/in). Rankings between strings differ by lab, so avoid stating tight stiffness order as fact.
